name: SnapDock
summary: A frosted glass dock, Windows-style snap layouts and one-click screenshots for Omarchy.
description:
SnapDock makes Omarchy feel instantly familiar, whether you're coming from Windows or macOS.

A DOCK MADE OF GLASS
A frosted dock sits at the bottom of your screen. It follows your theme automatically, or pick any colour and choose exactly how see-through it is. Pin the apps you love, unpin the ones you don't.

SNAP LIKE WINDOWS
Halves, quarters, thirds, two-thirds, fill or centre — arrange any window in one keystroke. Snapped windows resize from every edge.

TITLE BARS THAT WORK FOR YOU
Snap ⊞, maximize □ and close ✕, right where you expect them. Double-click a title bar to maximize.

SCREENSHOTS IN ONE CLICK
Tap the camera on the dock or press Shift + Print. The whole screen is copied to your clipboard and saved in Pictures.

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
Updates arrive with Omarchy's own Update, and SnapDock tells you when a new version is ready.

REMOVES CLEANLY
Uninstall from inside SnapDock and every setting goes back exactly the way it was.

featured.headline: Your desktop, finally familiar.
featured.tagline: A frosted glass dock and Windows-style snap layouts — made for Omarchy.

features.title: Frosted glass dock
features.body: Follows your theme, or pick any colour and transparency.

features.title: Snap layouts
features.body: Halves, quarters, thirds, two-thirds, fill and centre.

features.title: Smart title bars
features.body: Snap, maximize and close buttons. Double-click to maximize.

features.title: One-click screenshots
features.body: Copied to your clipboard and saved to Pictures.

steps.title: Get it
steps.body: Press GET. A terminal opens and asks for your password — that's Omarchy installing it safely.

steps.title: Open SnapDock
steps.body: Press Super + Space, type SnapDock, press Enter. The first launch sets up your dock and shortcuts.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Choose the dock's colour and glass, pin your favourite apps, and turn features on or off.

shortcuts.does: Show every snap layout for the current window
Fill the screen — or, after a half, snap to the top quarter
Put the window back — or, after a half, snap to the bottom quarter

faq.a: Yes — SnapDock is free for a limited time.

faq.q: Will it mess up my setup?
faq.a: No. SnapDock backs up every file it changes, and Uninstall restores everything exactly the way it was.

faq.q: Does it work with my theme?
faq.a: Yes. The dock and title bars recolour themselves whenever you switch Omarchy themes.
Omarchy's own Update keeps SnapDock current, and SnapDock tells you when a new version is ready.
Open SnapDock and choose Uninstall, then remove it from the store.
